pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I’M TRYING MY BEST TO NOT JUST CAUSE PROBLEMS… FOR SENSEI, BUT…

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HOW ABOUT YOUR "FRIENDS"?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT SEEMS NONE OF THE OTHERS EXCEPT THE “SQUAD LEADER” HAVE COME TO HAVE THEIR BLOOD DRAWN?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ...THE SAME AS USUAL. EVERYONE IS GOING AT THEIR OWN PACE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I'LL TELL EVERYONE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: TELL SASAKI-KUN PROPERLY TOO.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OKAY.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THE SQUAD LEADER AND SHIRAZU-KUN ARE BOTH ON INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATIONS, AREN'T THEY…?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: 1 WONDER IF SAIKO-CHAN... OVERSLEPT AGAIN... EVEN THOUGH SENSEI TOLD EVERYONE TO COOPERATE...

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WELL, BUT, EVEN IF I TELL THEM THEY WON'T LISTEN TO ME ANYHOW... OUCH!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AH...

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: I'M SORRY

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ..A GUY FROM THE "NEWLY ESTABLISHED UNIT"?

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: ...LOOKS SO WEAK. THOSE GUYS ARE OUR THE HIRAKO SQUAD’S, RIVALS?

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: I DON'T WANT THEM LOOKING DOWN ON US.

pages.speaker: character8
pages.text: NOW, NOW, I TOLD YOU "PLEASE GET ALONG", SINCE THEY ARE OUR COM-RADES.

pages.speaker: character8
pages.text: BUT, THEY ARE A SCARY SQUAD IN “SEVERAL WAYS”…

pages.speaker: character8
pages.text: WELL, I DON'T KNOW WHAT THE HIGHER UPS ARE THINKING.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: SO, HOW ABOUT IT? WHAT ABOUT THAT "NEWLY ESTABLISHED UNIT"?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: NAH. CONSIDERING ALL THE FANFARE WHEN IT WAS ESTABLISHED IT SEEMS LIKE IT ISN'T GOING TO PRODUCE ANY RESULTS AT ALL.
